name: @agent-engine/agent-landing-builder
description: The Landing Builder agent (s6, RFC-07) — the 7-phase INTAKE -> REFERENCE -> COPY -> COMPOSE -> MAKE -> GATE -> OUTPUT pipeline that turns one client's brand contract + intake facts into a standalone Next.js site, built on the sandboxed karos-landing tooling (template copy, write-fenced site writer, three-layer gate) plus a mandatory human review gate before delivery.
